decisions.reason: Selecting the landing-site subdomain URL does not change the Webflow platform or Basic hosting plan.
Routing the landing site to the selected subdomain is compatible with retaining the existing product at its root URL and does not change the candidate's routing requirement.
The selected subdomain URL does not alter the landing page's content mix, specification source, or screenshot selection.
The domain-routing selection has no effect on whether the landing page uses animations.
The selected subdomain URL does not change the site's visual style, palette, or approved design reference.
The landing-site subdomain selection does not change the dealer-login button's placement or destination URL.
The subdomain URL selection does not alter the hero asset, presentation, buttons, layout, or visual purpose.
The selected landing-site subdomain does not change the form-delivery trigger or email recipients.
